- `ht-role execution` gives `work.owed`, `work.changes` and `role_commits`: every role's published revision (its `main`, or the `dev` of the delivery root), though you can read only your own repository and the parts of others' the organization section names.
- Native `git`: `/hutian/repo` has `world/figtab-repo` as `origin`; but you can read only your own and what the organization section says of others'; what the whole world shares (the board) comes from `ht-role`, and its versions are the releases of `world/result`. Other repositories are not cloned for you. Clone accessible ones under `/hutian` with `--filter=blob:none` (files come as you read them), fetch before reading, and use `git show <commit>:<path>`. A repository's URL is `$HT_FORGEJO_URL/<owner>/<repo>.git`, and its wiki's `$HT_FORGEJO_URL/<owner>/<repo>.wiki.git` (pages are Markdown files on its `main`). `$HT_FORGEJO_URL` is the whole base URL (Git signs in for you) and changes from turn to turn: build every URL from it, never reuse an address from an earlier turn. Push and check the remote. Only the owner pushes branches and tags to a repository, and to its wiki, but for the root's `dev`. To propose changes where you read pull requests, base your commit on the target branch and `git push $HT_FORGEJO_URL/world/<role>.git HEAD:refs/for/<branch>/<topic>`. This opens a pull request; the newest commit message gives its title and description, and pushing the same topic updates it. Name the topic in the ref, give no push options, and push nothing else there. `forge` does not open these: read, discuss and review pull requests with `forge` or `forge api`. Copy SHAs from `role_commits` or `git rev-parse`, never from memory or shortened.
